description: This file is a Python script that serves as the front end for style-checker modules in the WebKit project. It includes class definitions, functions for configuration, and dispatching style checkers based on file types.

classes.name: FileType
classes.description: Enum-like class defining file type constants.

classes.name: CheckerDispatcher
classes.description: Class responsible for determining file types and dispatching appropriate style checkers based on file path and extension.

classes.name: StyleProcessorConfiguration
classes.description: Class storing configuration values for style processing, including confidence levels, report limits, and output formatting.

classes.name: ProcessorBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for processing lines of text from files.

classes.name: StyleProcessor
classes.description: Concrete class for checking style in files, managing error counting, and invoking specific checkers.

methods.name: should_process
methods.description: Determines if a file should be processed based on its path.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Checks the style of given lines in a file, reporting errors.

methods.name: is_reportable
methods.description: Determines if a style error should be reported based on confidence and filters.

methods.name: write_style_error
methods.description: Outputs a style error message to stderr.
